## Checklist

Tick each after checking it. The rules are in the
[README](https://github.com/dhinfra-at/use-cases/blob/main/README.md).

- [ ] No `.env`, credentials, API keys, tokens, private keys, or connection strings
- [ ] No internal hostnames, IP addresses, or non-public ports
- [ ] Notebook outputs cleared, or read in full
- [ ] No absolute paths carrying an account name
- [ ] No personal data, unpublished sources, or embargoed material
- [ ] No names of colleagues, students, or subjects in file names, metadata, or columns
- [ ] Third-party material names its source, licence, and required attribution
- [ ] Code under Apache-2.0, or the folder ships its own permissive licence file
- [ ] Material names an exact Creative Commons licence, in the README and in `LICENSE.txt`
- [ ] I am entitled to grant this, and I grant it indefinitely
- [ ] The folder is `candidates/NNN-slug/` with a README from `USE-CASE-TEMPLATE.md`
